comments.headline: Zoning information and case references incomplete
comments.summary: The cover sheet zoning section lacks required ordinance numbers, conditions, and restrictions. Final plat recording documentation is also missing. Per UCM 2.5.1(E), all applicable zoning ordinances, conditions, and final plat recording information must be documented.
comments.attn: ZLU-1.43 flagged in single run only; verify final plat document number requirement with zoning staff.

details.text: Zoning ordinance numbers not shown; only case number (C14-2011-0093) and MF-2 designation are present. Ordinance numbers such as 20120112-092 must be added.

runComments.comment: Zoning ordinance numbers are not referenced on the cover sheet. Only the zoning case number (C14-2011-0093) is shown. The applicable controlling ordinance (20120112-092) and secondary ordinance (19990225-070b) must be referenced on the cover sheet per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Zoning designation (MF-2) and case number (C14-2011-0093) are shown, but specific ordinance numbers governing the zoning designation are not referenced. Applicable zoning ordinance numbers must be included per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Zoning ordinance numbers not referenced on cover sheet. The cover sheet shows Zoning Case No. C14-2013-0093 and Zoning MF-2 but does not display the actual applicable zoning ordinance numbers (such as Ordinance No. 20120112-092). Both the zoning case number AND the ordinance numbers must be shown.

details.text: Zoning conditions and restrictions not noted. Site subject to LDC Subchapter F compatibility requirements due to adjacent SF-3 zoning: maximum 2 stories and 30-foot height within 25 feet of SF-3 lot line, with step-up schedule beyond.

runComments.comment: Zoning conditions and restrictions are not listed on the cover sheet. The project is subject to Residential Design Standards (Subchapter F) compatibility standards due to adjacency with SF-3 zoned property, including 2-story/30-foot height maximum within 25 feet of the SF-3 lot line and step-up schedule for structures beyond 25 feet. These restrictions must be noted on the cover sheet.

Site is subject to LDC Subchapter F (Residential Design Standards) compatibility requirements due to adjacent SF-3 zoning, including maximum 2-story / 30-foot height limit within 25 feet of SF-3 lot line and step-up schedule beyond. These zoning conditions and restrictions are not noted on the cover sheet as required.

Zoning conditions or restrictions not listed on cover sheet. The property is subject to Residential Design Standards (Subchapter F) compatibility standards triggered by the adjacent SF-3 parcel to the south, which limit structures within 25 feet of the SF-3 lot line to a maximum of 2 stories and 30 feet in height. These zoning conditions must be noted on the cover sheet.

details.text: Final plat legal description includes subdivision reference (Volume 73, Page 76, Mecey Subdivision) but omits recorded document/instrument number.

runComments.comment: Legal description shows the subdivision volume and page (Volume 73, Page 76, Mecey Subdivision), but the instrument or document recording number is not included. Complete final plat recording information including document/instrument number must be referenced per UCM 2.5.1.E.13.

comments.headline: Project team and legal instruments documentation incomplete
comments.summary: The cover sheet lacks required project team documentation and a comprehensive legal instruments section. Surveyor contact information is missing from the Site Development Data table, and recorded easements and maintenance agreements affecting the property are not listed. Per UCM 2.5.1(E), all team members and legal instruments must be documented.
comments.crossDep: Development Services and Legal (developer's counsel may be needed to compile complete list of recorded easements and maintenance agreements)

details.text: Surveyor's company name, address, and telephone number absent from Site Development Data table; only Owner, Engineer, Architect, and Landscape Architect contacts shown.

runComments.comment: Surveyor's company name, address, and telephone number are not shown on the cover sheet. The project team section lists Owner, Engineer, Architect, and Landscape Architect contact information, but no surveyor is listed. Surveyor information is required per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Project team contact information on the Site Development Data table includes Owner, Engineer, Architect, and Landscape Architect, but Surveyor company name, address, and telephone number are not provided. Surveyor contact information must be included per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Surveyor's company name, address, and telephone number not shown on cover sheet. The Surveyor role is entirely missing from the Site Development Data table. The surveyor's firm name, contact address, and phone number must be added to the table.

details.text: No legal instruments section documenting easements, covenants, and agreements. Property encumbered by Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) and City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137), among others.

runComments.comment: Required legal instruments are not comprehensively listed on the cover sheet. While a placeholder is provided for the IPM Restrictive Covenant document number, the cover sheet does not reference other recorded easements and maintenance instruments that encumber the property, including the City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137) and the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731). A complete list of all restrictive covenants, maintenance agreements, easements, and other legal instruments required for site approval must be included per UCM 2.5.1(E).

No dedicated section listing required legal instruments (restrictive covenants, maintenance agreements, easements, license agreements, subdivision recordation, or deferral agreements) is present on the cover sheet. All applicable legal instruments must be listed with their recording information per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Required legal instruments not listed on cover sheet. A consolidated 'Legal Instruments' section listing all easements, restrictive covenants, maintenance agreements, and other legal encumbrances affecting the property is missing. The property is encumbered by recorded easements including a Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731) and a City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137), among others, which must be documented on the cover sheet.

details.text: Maintenance agreement not referenced. Cover sheet notes privately maintained detention/biofiltration pond but lacks recorded maintenance agreement document number or placeholder.

runComments.comment: Maintenance agreement document number or placeholder is not referenced on the cover sheet. The site plan notes indicate that the proposed stacked biofiltration/detention pond will be privately maintained and must be maintained per Drainage and Environmental Criteria Manual standards. A maintenance agreement is required for this feature. The cover sheet must include either the recorded document number (if executed) or a placeholder in the format: 'For [Feature] Maintenance Agreement, see agreement filed in document No. ______' with document number to be added upon recording.

Site includes a privately maintained detention/biofiltration pond for stormwater management. The cover sheet notes general maintenance requirements but does not reference a recorded maintenance agreement document number. Once the maintenance agreement is formally recorded, the document number must be added to the cover sheet.

Maintenance agreement document number not referenced on cover sheet. The cover sheet states 'The proposed stacked biofiltration/detention pond will be privately maintained' but does not provide a recorded maintenance agreement document number or a placeholder for one. For a multi-family development with a water quality detention/biofiltration pond, a formal maintenance agreement referenced by recorded document number is required. Include a note in the format: 'Maintenance Agreement for [Facility Name] filed in document No. ________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas' with a blank placeholder if not yet recorded.
